column4: These end-of-chapter activities are designed to reinforce the core learning objectives of each chapter. Each activity is intended to take approximately 15-20 minutes to complete and may require additional resources not included in this book. Alongside personal reflection and group discussion questions, these activities are best utilized in a group study format to deepen understanding and engagement with the book’s key lessons. Use these activities as a guideline. Be creative, encourage participation, and modify the activities as you see fit.
